verses.en: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
verses.sm: Turo le savali ia Tavita, ua avatu foi laau o arasi ma tufuga ati fale, ma tufuga, ina ia fai aʻi se fale mona.

verses.en: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
verses.sm: Ona iloa ai lea e Tavita ua faatumauina o ia e le ALII e fai ma tupu ia Isaraelu, aua ua faamaualugaina lona malo ona o lona nuu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
verses.sm: Ua toe fai isi avá e Tavita i Ierusalema, ma ua toe fanau atalii O le lipi o Usa. ma afafine o Tavita.

verses.en: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.sm: O igoa nei o fanau o e na fanaua ia te ia i Ierusalema, o Samua, ma Sopapa, ma Natano, ma Solomona,

verses.en: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
verses.sm: ma Ivara, ma Elisua, ma Elefaleta,

verses.en: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.sm: ma Nokaa, ma Nefeku, ma lafia,

verses.en: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.sm: o Elisama, ma Peliata, ma Elifaleta.

verses.en: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Filisitia ua faauuina Tavita e fai ma tupu ia Isaraelu uma, ona o ae ai lea o Filisitia uma e saili ia Tavita. Ua logona foi e Tavita, ona alu atu ai lea ia te i latou.

verses.en: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.sm: Ua o atu foi Filisitia, ma ua salalau i latou i le vanu o sa Rafa.

verses.en: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
verses.sm: Ona fesili atu lea o Tavita i le Atua, ua faapea atu, Ou te alu ae ea e tau ma Filisitia? Pe e te tuuina mai i latou i loʻu lima? Ona faapea mai ai lea o Je AL ia te ia, Ina alu ae ia, aua ou te tuuina atu i latou i lou lima.

verses.en: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.sm: Ua latou o atu i Paalafaresa, ona fafasi lea e Tavita ia te i latou i lea mea; ona faapea mai ai lea o Tavita, Ua osofia e le Atua i loʻu lima o i latou e faia aʻu ma fili, e pei ona oso mai o le vai. O le mea lea ua latou faaigoa ai lea mea, O Paala-faresa.

verses.en: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.sm: Ua latou tuulafoai o latou atua i lea mea; ua fai atu ai Tavita, ona latou susunuina ai lea i le afi.

verses.en: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
verses.sm: Ua toe faapotopoto foi Filisitia, ma salalau i latou i le vanu.

verses.en: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.sm: Ua toe fesili atu Tavita i le Atua; ona faapea mai lea o le Atua ia te ia, Aua e te mulimuli atu ia te i latou, ia faataamilo ia te i latou, ma e alu atu ia te i latou Ole mea na osofia ai. i tala ane o laau o peka.

verses.en: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.sm: A E faalogologo i le pāūū o le savali mai i tumutumu o laau o peka, ona e alu atu ai lea e tau le taua; aua ua muamua atu le Atua i ou luma e fasi i le itu taua a Filisitia.

verses.en: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
verses.sm: Ona faia lea e Tavita, e pei ona fetalai mai ai o le Atua ia te ia. Ua latou fasia le itu taua a Filisitia, e afua i Kipeona e oo atu i Kasera.

verses.en: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu le logo o Tavita i nuu uma; ua tuu foi e le An i nuu uma ia matatau ia te ia.
